leads_only.name: Philadelphia FIGHT, Critical Path Learning Center
leads_only.note: Read once on 2026-10-08. Not written as a record because it is outside this batch. Free open access learning space at 1233 Locust Street, 2nd floor: adult education, GED prep, digital skills, a workforce course run with District 1199c, and health workshops. Drop in Monday, Wednesday and Friday, 10 am to 1 pm, or by appointment. Reached by redirect from the old web address of Center for Creative Activities (critpath.org/viscca). The link to that IRS entity is not confirmed.

They should be held back until someone finds a working site. 404s on cluw.org/local-chapters and cluw.org/contact-us were not used; the Local Chapters link was not found. Dropped from leads: Thomas Jefferson University women's rowing and Harriton High School Crew, which row from Crescent's boathouse. They are school and university teams, not community groups.
